title: price_risk_lambda's premium is booked as money: predicted_cost, baseline_cost, savings and prices carry lambda*sigma
claim: With price_risk_lambda > 0 the optimizer prices predicted_cost, baseline_cost, deferred cost and the published per-step prices on the risk-adjusted series, so predicted_cost != sum(raw price*power*dt) and the published saving is inflated by 12.46 currency at lambda 1 (25.06 at the config maximum 2.0) on the price_risk golden, where the thermostat baseline runs through the guessed tail the plan avoids.
mechanism: optimizer.optimize replaces prices with _stash_price_horizon's return (prices + lambda*sigma on unknown steps); every _Horizon closure (energy_cost_of) and _build_result (prices=h.prices) reads that array. The premium is a planning device (#34), never paid; the coordinator publishes predicted_cost/baseline_cost/predicted_savings and schedule[].price from the result and the accuracy promise (note_promise) reads result.prices.

evidence.contention_note: fan-out: up to three seats share the box; a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb-raw: the risk premium stays in the solve, the published figures are priced on the raw series

metric_definition: savings_inflation = (baseline_cost - raw-priced baseline) - (predicted_cost - raw-priced plan spend), the published saving's gain from prices nobody pays
phenomenon_property: Every published money figure and per-step price of a plan is the raw input price series' (plus PV piecewise); a risk premium may shape the solve but never the reported spend, baseline or saving.

null_control.note: lambda 0 on the same golden: every premium 0; also the 49 other goldens (lambda 0) close predicted-cost-sum to 0 in m3_objective.py

proposed_fix_scope: optimizer: keep the raw series beside the risk-adjusted one in _Horizon; price predicted/baseline/deferred and publish prices on the raw one
